title: Doorman + Venator: Cart through a door onto Snap Trap
question: Does a Cart push carry an enemy through a door onto an armed Snap Trap, and how long is the target locked?
hypothesis: H-B3-2.1 a carted hero passes through Doorway and exits at the other door. H-B3-2.2 a trap 1-2m in front of the exit door roots them (2.25s T2, ~2.75s with Duration Extender). H-B3-2.3 Gutshot at the exit door wall-stuns every time (door on wall, 7m). H-B3-2.4 time-to-kill on a 2500 HP bot drops >=30% vs Venator fighting the bot in the open.

arms.name: open_field
arms.notes: base Venator chases the bot, no Doorman

arms.name: door_trap
arms.notes: Doorman doors + Cart, trap at exit door

setup.position: exit door on a wall near Venator; entry door 30m away beside the bot

enemies.behaviour: walks away at full speed when hit

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Doorman places doors; Venator kicks a trap 1.5m in front of the exit door
Doorman Carts the bot into the entry door
Venator Gutshots toward the wall, then heavy melee
Record root duration, wall stun yes/no, time to kill

metrics.name: time_to_kill
metrics.how: stopwatch from first hit to death

decision.rule: SUPPORTS if door_trap is >=30% faster with non-overlapping ranges. If cart_through_door is false, change the combo to carting straight onto the trap (no door) and retest. If REFUTED, put Warp Stone back in venator_duo_doorman.
